title: WHAT A NIGHT!!! 🎭🪩✨ Opening night of Much Ado About Nothing on Broadw...
transcript: There is nothing more special than an opening night on Broadway, but getting to go to the opening of a star studded Jamie Lloyd production, I might have peaked. I saw Jamie Lloyd's much ado about nothing in London last year and I loved it. So I was really excited to be there for its Broadway opening. Anytime I get to go to an opening, I love to check out the carpet. And this one was stacked. And look, Bassett Kid, Cudi Oak and of course, Rachel Zegler with Jamie because she's starring in Evita, his next production. And then I walked into the theater and it was basically like a full on club, crazy lights, blasting music. They have club dancers literally dancing in the aisles. The energy in the room was electric and everyone looked so good. But before I knew it, it was showtime. If you're unfamiliar, much ado about nothing is one of Shakespeare's most delightful comedies full of witty banter and ridiculous misunderstandings and two people who are very obviously in love and just refuse to admit it. My favourite genre. And Jamie Lloyd takes a silliness and turns it up to 11. It's disco balls and mascot masks and so much pink confetti. Tom Hiddleston is the most insanely charming person of all time and also made me swoon with his romantic speeches. And a Haley Atwell so snarky, literally could not stop laughing. And I am obsessed with Mason Eldenberg. They just get To sing and it's perfect. Much ado is already one of my favourite Shakespeare's when the world just feels so hellish. A night dancing and laughing and just getting swept up in the joy of live theatre is exactly what I need. It's truly more chaotic than you can imagine. You gotta go. But luckily the night was not over yet cause we were headed to the opening night party was at Tavern on the green. I was pinching myself. Such a beautiful iconic New York City venue. There was great food and drinks and they had these cute custom coasters. I may have taken a few home. And they really a fun light up dance floor. I love being surrounded by theatre people. And then much ado about nothing got a New York Times Critic's Pick. So deserve the best. Thank you so much to Mark Levine and Gemini Theatrical for inviting me to celebrate. Congratulations on a spectacular opening and go see much ado about nothing.
